_read_this_first: No third-party source is committed to this repository. `repos` is empty until someone deliberately runs benchmarks/vendor.py, which fetches permissively licensed code only on explicit invocation and writes a NOTICE.md per repo. See docs/08-benchmarks.md.

smoke.description: Hermetic pipeline check: fast, deterministic, no network, no third-party code. Proves the engine and the harness — never model quality.

repo_scale.description: Multi-step, cross-file tasks with a test_command at the end. Meaningful only when run with a real provider; under the canned provider its quality checks are reported as skipped rather than passed.

review.description: Deep review against the standard critic (docs/21 P1). Each task hands the reviewers a fixed diff with one planted defect, or a correct diff as a control, once per mode. Meaningful only with a real provider; under the canned provider the quality checks are reported as skipped, and what is proved is the wiring and the call cap.

+
 
 def greet(name: str) -> str:
     """Say hello. The benchmark's tasks are measured against this file."""
@@ -10,3 +12,12 @@ def shout(name: str) -> str:
     prove that nothing broke."""
     return greet(name).upper()
+
+
+API_TOKEN = "sk-test-0000000000000000"
+
+
+def fetch_greeting(name: str) -> str:
+    request = urllib.request.Request("https://greetings.example.invalid/" + name)
+    request.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + API_TOKEN)
